description: This file defines the MultiTrustManager class, which implements the X509TrustManager interface to manage multiple KeyStores for SSL certificate trust validation.

classes.name: MultiTrustManager
classes.description: A class that manages multiple KeyStores to validate SSL certificates, implementing custom trust logic.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given KeyStore.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes an empty list of KeyStores.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a KeyStore to the list of managed keystores.

methods.name: getNumberOfKeyStores
methods.description: Returns the number of KeyStores managed.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the client certificates are trusted based on internal logic and properties.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the server certificates are trusted based on internal logic and properties.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns an array of trusted X509Certificates from all managed KeyStores.

methods.name: isTrusted
methods.description: Determines if a given set of certificates is trusted by comparing with accepted issuers.
